request.text: Compare iCloud and a local folder for keeping my notes.

reply.raw:
Both work. iCloud Drive keeps notes synced across your Apple devices and backed up off the Mac, but it depends on your storage plan and on sync. A local folder is simpler and always available offline, but it only has the backups you set up yourself.
